title: Error envelope (ADR 7)
description: The one body every non-2xx JSON answer carries, on /api/v1/ and on the pre-v1 endpoints. request_id equals the X-Request-Id response header.

code.description: invalid_param (400): a parameter is malformed, field names it. not_found (404): no card has the id. unauthorized (401): an X-Api-Key header names no configured key. es_unavailable (503): Elasticsearch did not answer.

field.description: The parameter at fault; absent when no single parameter is.
